research_topic: MambaFormer Efficiency Architecture for Inference Speed Improvement Design a hybrid architecture integrating linear-complexity state space models (Mamba) with attention mechanisms (Transformer) to achieve 50%+ improvement in inference speed (tokens/sec) and memory efficiency (MB/token) compared to existing SOTA, evaluated on WikiText-103 (https://huggingface.co/datasets/wikitext) and GLUE/SuperGLUE (https://gluebenchmark.com/) with accuracy degradation within 2%, using 300M-500M parameter lightweight models against Transformer (GPT-2 small), Mamba (130M), and RetNet baselines.
